bootstrap: go.mod is provisional and is not a reproducible release baseline. Its Go directive is a bootstrap minimum, not the selected toolchain.
compilerTarget: windows/amd64; UCRT; POSIX threads; x86-64 SEH
requirements: Review availability, provenance, source contents, build suitability, security and licenses for every selected component and transitive module.
Record a reviewer and rationale for every replacement of a proposed pin.
Inspect the binding's bundled raylib, GLFW and every decoder, including revisions and license texts.
Compare observed archive digests with separately reviewed trusted digests.
Do not freeze a baseline until Windows SDK inputs, native builds, licensing and reproducibility evidence are reviewed.
